answer_text: Yes, by its own account. Defang says an attacker got into its build system on Nov 12, copied the credentials it runs on and downloaded its main database. It found out on Nov 23.
label: Confirmed

question_text: Could the attacker get into my GitHub repositories or cloud account?
answer_text: Possibly, if you installed the Defang GitHub App: until Nov 23 the stolen key could act in your repositories, and through them reach your cloud deploy role. Defang says it does not yet know whether it was used.
label: Confirmed

question_text: Do I need to change any passwords?
answer_text: Not a Defang password: it has none. If you deployed with Defang between Oct 12 and Nov 19, Defang says to change your database passwords and other secrets and redeploy.
label: Confirmed

question_text: Were the stolen credentials used after November 12?
what_would_settle_it: Defang finishing its log review and updating its post, or GitHub reporting what its audit of token use found.

question_text: Who was behind the Defang breach?
what_would_settle_it: Defang, law enforcement or a credible independent analysis naming the attacker.

question_text: How many Defang users were affected?
what_would_settle_it: Defang giving a number of accounts. It says everyone with a Defang Portal account is in the copied database.

question_text: Is the Defang breach linked to the 1Password and Todoist breaches?
answer_text: Not established. All three went through GitHub access in the same weeks, as commenters point out, but each company describes a different route in, and none has linked them.
label: Not established
what_would_settle_it: One of the companies, GitHub or a credible independent analysis linking or separating them.

question_text: Which organisations use Defang, and were they affected?
answer_text: Not publicly known. Defang names no customers, and no organisation has said it uses Defang or was affected. Those most at risk installed the Defang GitHub App and deploy from GitHub.
label: Not established
what_would_settle_it: An organisation saying it uses Defang and whether it was affected, or Defang naming affected customers.
